# All-in-One B2B Lead & Corporate Domain Intelligence Suite (`b2b-lead-domain-intelligence-suite-mcp-api`)

> Extracts executive contacts, validates emails via MX/DNS, audits DMARC/SPF/SSL, and detects tech stack.

## Endpoints & Connections
- Apify Store URL: https://apify.com/deepaksheoran172/b2b-lead-domain-intelligence-suite
- Remote MCP (Streamable HTTP): `https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=deepaksheoran172/b2b-lead-domain-intelligence-suite`
- Stdio MCP: `npx -y @apify/actors-mcp-server --actors deepaksheoran172/b2b-lead-domain-intelligence-suite`
- Execution Mode: Serverless Batch & MCP Tool
- Full 63-Actor Catalog: https://deepakshe.github.io/b2b-mcp-apify-scrapers-hub/llms.txt
